narration_script: That horizontal split is not your GPU failing. It is two finished frames sharing one display refresh. A fixed-refresh screen scans a new image on its own clock, line by line from top to bottom. The GPU finishes frames on a different schedule, and scene complexity changes that delivery time from moment to moment. If the displayed buffer changes mid-scan, the upper lines can show one frame while lower lines show the next. V-Sync waits for a refresh boundary, while variable refresh rate changes the display timing to meet a finished frame. So tearing is a presentation mismatch, not a broken texture or low resolution. Two clocks simply crossed mid-picture.
